title: Microsoft Azure
intro: Microsoft Azure interview questions cover the platform common in enterprise Java backend roles — Azure Spring Apps for managed Spring Boot, AKS and Azure Container Registry, Azure Functions for serverless Java, the storage stack (Blob, SQL Database, Cosmos DB), the messaging stack (Service Bus vs Event Hubs), Key Vault and Managed Identity for passwordless auth, Azure Active Directory with Spring Security, and Application Insights for observability. Use this page when the job description mentions Azure or Microsoft-shop tooling.
